_source: SIA 265:2021, Tabelle 38 (clause 6.5.2.3.3) -- transcribed by hand from the German edition, SIA265-2021-DE.pdf p. 75, read off a render of the page; the French wording from SIA265-2021-FR.pdf p. 76.
_note: The footnotes are the norm's rules restated in a sentence each, under the norm's own numbering, and not its paragraphs: a norm is cited and never reproduced (docs/architecture/reference-library.md §11bis). The multiples of d, the floors in mm and the conditions are transcribed exactly. The first diameter column is headed «d = 4 mm» in both the German (p. 75) and the French (p. 76) edition, where Tabelle 28 heads the same column «d ≤ 4 mm»; it is read here as d ≤ 4 mm, which is what makes the two columns cover every diameter, and `printed` keeps what the page says. The loaded edge's 13 d spans both columns.

table_38.title: Minimale Abstände bei Schraubenverbindungen ohne Vorbohrung mit $d_1 \/ d <= 0.75$

footnotes.1: Gültig für $rho_k <= 420$ kg/m³; für $rho_k > 420$ kg/m³ ist vorzubohren.
footnotes.2: Der Abstand vom unbeanspruchten Rand darf auf $4 d$ reduziert werden, wenn die Mindestholzdicke gleichzeitig auf $14 d$ erhöht wird.
